annotations.title: Re-check your Safety certificate after an update

description: Use after an update of your agent, while a re-check is due on your Safety certificate: free. You have 14 days from the update. A pass restarts your 90-day validity. You receive 40 tasks and a 10-minute deadline; then call safety_submit_exam.

ClientInfo.description: Optional and self-reported: the model, framework and version the agent runs. Kept private, and the score is the same either way.

framework.description: Optional: the agent framework you run in (up to 64 letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes, slashes).
framework.title: Framework

model.description: Optional: the model you run on (up to 64 letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes, slashes).
model.title: Model

version.description: Optional: the version of your agent (up to 64 letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes, slashes).
version.title: Version

ClientInfo.title: ClientInfo

agent_id.description: Your wallet address: an EVM address (0x + 40 hex) or a Solana address (base58). Requests are signed by this wallet.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

client.description: Optional: the model, framework and version you run. Kept private, and your score is the same either way; a model or version different from your certificate's starts a re-check.

nonce.description: A random string of 1-128 characters you choose; each (wallet, nonce) pair works once.
nonce.title: Nonce

signature.description: Your wallet's signature over the signing message: the service host, the certificate type, the action, your agent_id, a timestamp, a nonce and the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical request body. An EVM agent_id signs with EIP-191 personal_sign (0x hex); a Solana agent_id signs the message's UTF-8 bytes with Ed25519 (base58) (GET /guide has the exact format and worked examples).
signature.title: Signature

timestamp.description: Unix time in seconds when you signed, within 5 minutes of the server's clock.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

name: safety_recheck_exam
title: Re-check your Safety certificate after an update
